  "overall_experience": "This entrepreneur likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for managing their project tasks and deadlines as a self-employed individual. Its simplicity suited their need for basic task list and project management without overwhelming features. However, the limitation of the free plan to a single project and the lack of more sophisticated functionalities may have occasionally constrained their workflow, especially within the demanding Investment Banking industry."
